UserVideo.title: UserVideo
UserVideo.description: Represents a generated Veo user research quote video linked to a specific user account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video record

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this video

quote.description: The synthesized user research quote text

candidateName.description: Name of the research participant candidate

generatedDate.description: Formatted date string when the video was created

thumbnailUrl.description: Reference URL or portrait path for the video thumbnail

durationSec.description: Duration in seconds of the video

videoUrl.description: Playback URL or blob reference for the video

promptUsed.description: The exact Veo generation prompt used

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the record was created

/users/{userId}/videos/{videoId}.description: Subcollection of videos generated and owned by the authenticated user.
